title: Total Cookie Protection
description: Learn how Oasis's Total Cookie Protection contains cookies to the site you're on, preventing trackers from following you between websites and enhancing your privacy.
content:
Total Cookie Protection is a revolutionary privacy feature in Oasis that contains cookies to the specific website you're visiting, preventing trackers from using them to follow you across different sites. This innovative approach to cookie management significantly enhances your privacy by isolating tracking cookies and preventing cross-site tracking while maintaining the functionality you need for legitimate website features.

Pro Tip

Total Cookie Protection is enabled by default in Oasis and works automatically to protect your privacy. It's designed to maintain website functionality while preventing cross-site tracking through cookies.

What Is Total Cookie Protection?

Total Cookie Protection is an advanced privacy feature that fundamentally changes how cookies work in your browser. Instead of allowing cookies to be shared across websites (which enables cross-site tracking), Total Cookie Protection isolates cookies to the specific website where they were created. This prevents trackers from building comprehensive profiles of your browsing behavior across multiple sites.

How Traditional Cookies Work

Without Total Cookie Protection:

  • Cross-Site Sharing: Cookies can be accessed across multiple websites
  • Tracking Profiles: Companies build detailed profiles of your behavior
  • Targeted Advertising: Ads follow you across different sites
  • Privacy Invasion: Your browsing history is tracked and analyzed
  • Data Collection: Extensive data collection without your knowledge

How Total Cookie Protection Works

With Total Cookie Protection:

  • Site Isolation: Cookies are contained to individual websites
  • Cross-Site Blocking: Prevents cookies from being shared between sites
  • Privacy Preservation: Maintains your privacy across the web
  • Functionality Maintained: Essential website features still work
  • Automatic Protection: Works seamlessly in the background

How Total Cookie Protection Works

Cookie Containment

The core mechanism of Total Cookie Protection:

  • Site-Specific Storage: Each website gets its own isolated cookie storage
  • Cross-Site Isolation: Cookies cannot be accessed by other websites
  • Automatic Separation: Different sites' cookies are automatically separated
  • Transparent Operation: Works without requiring user intervention
  • Performance Optimized: Minimal impact on browsing speed

Protection Mechanisms

How Total Cookie Protection prevents tracking:

  • Domain Isolation: Cookies are isolated by website domain
  • Third-Party Blocking: Prevents third-party cookies from tracking
  • Cross-Site Requests: Blocks cross-site cookie requests
  • Fingerprinting Prevention: Reduces cookie-based fingerprinting
  • Profile Building Prevention: Stops comprehensive user profiling

Smart Cookie Management

Intelligent handling of different cookie types:

  • Essential Cookies: Allows necessary cookies for website functionality
  • Tracking Cookies: Blocks or isolates tracking-related cookies
  • Session Cookies: Maintains session cookies for current browsing
  • Authentication Cookies: Preserves login and authentication cookies
  • Preference Cookies: Keeps user preference cookies for current site

Benefits of Total Cookie Protection

Privacy Benefits

How Total Cookie Protection enhances your privacy:

  • Cross-Site Tracking Prevention: Stops trackers from following you across sites
  • Profile Building Blocked: Prevents comprehensive user profiling
  • Reduced Data Collection: Limits the amount of data collected about you
  • Anonymous Browsing: Makes it harder to identify you across websites
  • Behavioral Tracking Prevention: Stops tracking of your browsing patterns

Security Benefits

Security improvements from Total Cookie Protection:

  • Reduced Attack Surface: Fewer cookies means fewer potential security vulnerabilities
  • Session Isolation: Prevents session hijacking across sites
  • Data Leakage Prevention: Stops accidental data sharing between sites
  • Malicious Cookie Blocking: Prevents harmful cookies from affecting other sites
  • Enhanced Privacy Controls: Gives you more control over your data

User Experience Benefits

How it improves your browsing experience:

  • Reduced Targeted Ads: Fewer ads that follow you across sites
  • Faster Loading: Less tracking code means faster page loads
  • Cleaner Browsing: Less intrusive tracking and profiling
  • Maintained Functionality: Essential website features still work properly
  • Transparent Operation: Works automatically without user intervention

How Total Cookie Protection Differs from Traditional Cookie Blocking

Traditional Cookie Blocking

How conventional cookie blocking works:

  • All-or-Nothing Approach: Blocks all cookies or allows all cookies
  • Website Breakage: Often breaks essential website functionality
  • Manual Configuration: Requires extensive user configuration
  • Limited Effectiveness: Can be bypassed by sophisticated trackers
  • User Burden: Users must manage complex settings

Total Cookie Protection

How Oasis's approach is different:

  • Smart Isolation: Isolates cookies rather than blocking them entirely
  • Functionality Preserved: Maintains essential website features
  • Automatic Operation: Works seamlessly without user configuration
    • Superior Protection: More effective against cross-site tracking
  • User-Friendly: No complex settings to manage
Privacy Note

Total Cookie Protection is designed to maintain website functionality while providing superior privacy protection. It's more sophisticated than simple cookie blocking and provides better protection against cross-site tracking.

Understanding Cookie Types and Protection

First-Party Cookies

How Total Cookie Protection handles first-party cookies:

  • Site-Specific Storage: Cookies are stored for the current website only
  • Functionality Maintained: Essential site features continue to work
  • Login Sessions: Authentication cookies work normally
  • User Preferences: Site preferences are preserved
  • Shopping Carts: E-commerce functionality remains intact

Third-Party Cookies

How third-party cookies are handled:

  • Cross-Site Blocking: Third-party cookies cannot track across sites
  • Isolated Storage: Each site's third-party cookies are isolated
  • Tracking Prevention: Prevents cross-site tracking via third-party cookies
  • Selective Blocking: Blocks tracking cookies while allowing functional ones
  • Enhanced Privacy: Significantly reduces tracking capabilities

Session vs. Persistent Cookies

Different handling for different cookie types:

  • Session Cookies: Maintained for current browsing session
  • Persistent Cookies: Stored but isolated to specific sites
  • Authentication Cookies: Preserved for login functionality
  • Analytics Cookies: Isolated to prevent cross-site tracking
  • Advertising Cookies: Blocked or isolated to prevent tracking

How to Check Total Cookie Protection Status

Shield Icon Indicator

Understanding the shield icon in the address bar:

  • Gray Shield: No trackers detected or protection is off
  • Purple Shield: Trackers (including cookies) were blocked
  • Shield with Number: Number of tracking elements blocked
  • Shield with Cookie Icon: Cookie-related protection active
  • Click for Details: Click shield to see what was blocked

Privacy Reports

Viewing detailed cookie protection information:

  • Weekly Reports: Regular summaries of cookie protection
  • Cookie Statistics: Number and types of cookies handled
  • Cross-Site Tracking: Reports on cross-site tracking attempts
  • Protection Effectiveness: How well protection is working
  • Site-Specific Data: Cookie protection data for specific sites

Settings Verification

How to verify Total Cookie Protection is active:

  • Privacy Settings: Check Enhanced Tracking Protection settings
  • Cookie Settings: Verify cookie blocking preferences
  • Protection Level: Ensure appropriate protection level is set
  • Site Exceptions: Review any site-specific exceptions
  • Browser Updates: Ensure Oasis is up to date

Managing Total Cookie Protection

Accessing Settings

How to access Total Cookie Protection settings:

  1. Open Oasis Settings (Menu → Settings)
  2. Navigate to "Privacy & Security" section
  3. Find "Enhanced Tracking Protection"
  4. Click on "Cookies and Site Data"
  5. Configure cookie blocking preferences
  6. Set site-specific exceptions if needed

Customizing Protection

Options for customizing cookie protection:

  • Protection Levels: Choose between standard and strict protection
  • Site Exceptions: Allow specific sites to bypass protection
  • Cookie Categories: Choose which types of cookies to block
  • Cross-Site Settings: Configure cross-site cookie blocking
  • Third-Party Settings: Control third-party cookie behavior

Site-Specific Management

Managing cookies for specific websites:

  • Allow Specific Sites: Disable protection for trusted websites
  • Block Specific Sites: Enable strict protection for certain sites
  • Cookie Permissions: Set specific cookie permissions per site
  • Exception Management: View and edit site exceptions
  • Import/Export: Share settings between devices

Compatibility and Website Functionality

Maintained Functionality

Website features that continue to work:

  • User Logins: Authentication and login sessions work normally
  • Shopping Carts: E-commerce functionality is preserved
  • Site Preferences: User preferences and settings are maintained
  • Form Data: Form auto-fill and saved data work properly
  • Essential Features: Core website functionality is unaffected

Potential Issues

When you might encounter problems:

  • Cross-Site Features: Features that rely on cross-site cookies
  • Third-Party Services: Some third-party integrations may be affected
  • Analytics Tools: Website analytics may be limited
  • Social Media Integration: Some social features may not work
  • Advertising Networks: Targeted ads may be less effective

Troubleshooting

How to resolve compatibility issues:

  • Site Exceptions: Add problematic sites to exception list
  • Lower Protection Level: Try standard instead of strict protection
  • Clear Cookies: Clear cookies and try again
  • Check Settings: Verify cookie protection settings
  • Report Issues: Report broken sites to Mozilla

Privacy and Security Considerations

Privacy Benefits

How Total Cookie Protection enhances privacy:

  • Cross-Site Tracking Prevention: Stops tracking across multiple sites
  • Profile Building Blocked: Prevents comprehensive user profiling
  • Reduced Data Collection: Limits tracking data collection
  • Anonymous Browsing: Makes cross-site identification harder
  • Behavioral Tracking Prevention: Stops tracking of browsing patterns

Security Enhancements

Security improvements from cookie isolation:

  • Session Isolation: Prevents session hijacking across sites
  • Data Leakage Prevention: Stops accidental data sharing
  • Malicious Cookie Blocking: Prevents harmful cookies from spreading
  • Reduced Attack Surface: Fewer cookies means fewer vulnerabilities
  • Enhanced Control: Better control over your data
Security Note

Total Cookie Protection significantly enhances your privacy and security by preventing cross-site tracking while maintaining essential website functionality. It's a more sophisticated approach than traditional cookie blocking.

Best Practices for Total Cookie Protection

Privacy Best Practices

Maximizing your privacy protection:

  • Keep Protection Enabled: Leave Total Cookie Protection active
  • Use Strict Protection: Enable strict protection for maximum privacy
  • Regular Reviews: Periodically review site exceptions
  • Monitor Reports: Check privacy reports regularly
  • Stay Updated: Keep Oasis updated for latest protection

Compatibility Best Practices

Balancing privacy with functionality:

  • Test Important Sites: Test essential websites with protection enabled
  • Use Exceptions Wisely: Only add exceptions for trusted sites
  • Start with Standard: Begin with standard protection level
  • Monitor Performance: Watch for any performance impacts
  • Report Issues: Help improve protection by reporting problems

Security Best Practices

Additional security considerations:

  • Regular Updates: Keep Oasis updated for security patches
  • Use HTTPS: Ensure secure connections when possible
  • Strong Passwords: Use strong, unique passwords
  • Two-Factor Authentication: Enable 2FA where available
  • Regular Security Checks: Monitor for security issues

Frequently Asked Questions

General Questions

Common questions about Total Cookie Protection:

  • Is it enabled by default? Yes, Total Cookie Protection is enabled by default
  • Does it break websites? No, it's designed to maintain functionality
  • Can I disable it? Yes, but it's not recommended for privacy
  • Does it slow down browsing? No, it typically improves performance
  • Is it available on mobile? Yes, it works on mobile devices

Technical Questions

Technical aspects of Total Cookie Protection:

  • How does it work? Isolates cookies to individual websites
  • Does it update automatically? Yes, protection updates automatically
  • Can I see what's blocked? Yes, check the shield icon for details
  • Does it work offline? No, it requires internet connection
  • Can I customize it? Yes, through privacy settings

Privacy Questions

Privacy-related concerns:

  • Is my data still collected? Protection reduces but doesn't eliminate all collection
  • Does it work with VPNs? Yes, it works alongside VPN services
  • Can websites detect it? Some sites may detect protection but can't bypass it
  • Is it 100% effective? No protection is 100% effective, but it significantly improves privacy
  • Does it affect login sessions? No, it doesn't interfere with legitimate login functionality

Additional Resources

For more information about Total Cookie Protection, we recommend:

Mozilla Total Cookie Protection Guide - Official guide from Mozilla

Firefox Total Cookie Protection - Detailed technical guide

Important Disclaimer

This guide discusses Oasis Total Cookie Protection, which is based on Mozilla's Firefox Total Cookie Protection technology. The cookie protection features and privacy practices described are specific to Oasis's implementation. Other browsers may have different cookie protection systems and privacy practices.

Note: Oasis has a version derived from Firefox core, which is why it shares similar cookie protection capabilities and can benefit from Mozilla's privacy-focused approach to preventing cross-site tracking.
